repos_data.description: zsh and bash theme for display git status in command prompt
simple zsh theme with git info
Zsh plugin to enhance the git status visualization
simple Oh My Zsh theme with git_status and git_info
An oh-my-zsh plugin that automatically updates your prompt when git status changes, using fswatch to monitor repository files in real-time.

repo_meta_data.description: This Zsh prompt configuration adds Git status symbols and tracks command execution time. It customizes the prompt with virtual environment details, user info, and the current directory, including Git repository info. The prompt adapts based on the user’s context and provides a clean, informative display.
